decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral-to-slightly-negative today with NASDAQ down 0.2% and S&P 500 down 0.5%. None of the top candidates showed the full multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, RSI in bullish zone, price above SMA-20, and volume surge) needed for a high-conviction buy, so we held cash and existing positions rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted lower today, with the S&P 500 underperforming the NASDAQ, suggesting a mild rotation away from risk rather than a sharp sell-off. Momentum candidates on our screener showed bullish technicals but lacked confirming volume, which historically has meant weaker follow-through. With no clear risk-on catalyst, staying in cash on the sidelines preserves capital for a more convincing setup.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍走弱，標普500指數跌幅大於納斯達克指數，顯示市場資金正溫和地從風險資產撤出，而非出現急跌。雖然篩選名單中部分股票技術面呈現看漲訊號，但普遍缺乏成交量放大的確認，過去經驗顯示此類訊號後續動能往往不足。在缺乏明確風險偏好回升訊號的情況下，暫時持有現金以待更明確的進場時機。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors pull back slightly from stocks even without a major shock, often shown by broad indices drifting lower together. The right response isn't to panic-sell or force new buys, but to hold steady and wait for a clearer signal in either direction.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）是指投資人在沒有重大利空的情況下，仍小幅減碼股票，通常表現為主要指數同步走軟。正確的應對方式不是恐慌性賣出，也不是勉強買入，而是保持觀望，等待更明確的市場方向訊號。
